lessons.title: Lesson 1.1: Java Architecture — JDK, JRE, JVM & JIT Compiler

challenge.task: Print 'Hello Java' to the console in Java.

lessons.content:
⚡
30-Second Mental Model

Java code pehle javac compiler se .class bytecode mein compile hota hai, fir JVM ka JIT (Just-In-Time) compiler use direct native machine code mein convert karta hai (Write Once, Run Anywhere).

JVM Engine
WORA Principle

Write Once, Run Anywhere via JVM Bytecode.

Performance
JIT Compiler

Hotspots compiled to native CPU instructions.

JVM Lifecycle

Java source code (.java) -> Bytecode (.class) -> ClassLoader -> JIT -> CPU Execution.

lessons.title: Lesson 1.2: Primitive Data Types & Stack vs Heap Allocation

challenge.task: Declare int x = 40, int y = 60, print their sum.

lessons.content:
⚡
30-Second Mental Model

Primitive variables (int, double, boolean) stack memory mein direct binary values hold karte hain, jabki Objects heap memory mein allocate hote hain.

Stack vs Heap
Primitive Memory

Stored directly on Stack frames with ultra-fast access.

Memory Layout

Primitives live in stack frames and are destroyed when method returns.

lessons.title: Lesson 1.3: Arithmetic Operators, Modulo & Math Utility Class

challenge.task: Calculate 15 modulo 4 using % and print result.

lessons.content:
⚡
30-Second Mental Model

Integer division Java mein fractional part truncate kar deta hai. Fractional precision ke liye kam se kam ek operand float/double hona chahiye.

Math Math
Modulo & Division

Integer division truncates towards zero.

Arithmetic Rules

Modulo operator (%) circular index buffers aur even/odd tests ke liye vital hai.

modules.title: Module 2: Control Flow & Decision Logic
modules.description: if-else branching, logical short-circuiting, traditional switch fallthrough, and modern Java 14+ switch expressions.

lessons.title: Lesson 2.1: Decision Branching & Logical Short-Circuit Operators

challenge.task: Write an if-else statement checking if int temperature = 32 is > 30. Print 'Hot' or 'Cool'.
challenge.hint: int t=32; if(t>30) System.out.println("Hot"); else System.out.println("Cool");

lessons.content:
⚡
30-Second Mental Model

Short-circuit operators (&&, ||) pehle expression se hi result decide ho jane par dusra expression evaluate nahi karte, jisse NullPointerExceptions se bacha ja sakta hai.

Short Circuit
&& and || Logic

Guards against NPE when checking object != null && object.isValid().

Conditional Execution

Fast boolean evaluation pipelines.

lessons.title: Lesson 2.2: Traditional Switch Statements & Fallthrough Mechanics

challenge.task: Write a switch on int code = 1 with case 1 printing 'OK'. Include break.
challenge.hint: int code = 1; switch(code){ case 1: System.out.println("OK"); break; }

lessons.content:
⚡
30-Second Mental Model

Traditional switch statements mein 'break' miss karne par code agle case mein slip kar jata hai (Fallthrough).

Switch Logic
Break Guard

Explicit termination of branch execution.

Switch Jump Table

Compiler generates O(1) tableswitch/lookupswitch bytecode.

lessons.title: Lesson 2.3: Modern Enhanced Switch Expressions (Java 14+)

challenge.task: Write an arrow switch expression returning 'Admin' for role = 'ADMIN' and print it.
challenge.hint: String r = "ADMIN"; String title = switch(r) { case "ADMIN" -> "Admin"; default -> "User"; }; System.out.println(title);

Labeled Loops

Instant jump out of deep nested loop structures.

Clean multi-level loop termination pattern.

challenge.task: Create an ArrayList of Integers, add 10 and 20, and print size().

lessons.content:
⚡

Collections

Dynamic array with continuous memory locality.

ArrayList is the default list choice for 99% of enterprise applications.

challenge.task: Store key 'user' with value 'admin' in HashMap and print get('user').

lessons.content:
⚡

Hash Table
HashMap Engine

Constant-time key lookup and collision resolution via tree nodes.

Array of Buckets -> LinkedList -> Red-Black Tree (TREEIFY_THRESHOLD = 8).
